name: reflect
description: Turns your corrections ("no, use pnpm", "never do X") into rules you can save to CLAUDE.md with one click.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Send prompts that look like corrections to a small model to propose a rule. /reflect on|off toggles it too.

model.title: Model
model.description: Alias or id of the small model that reads those prompts (default haiku).

includeLastReply.title: Send last reply
includeLastReply.description: Also send the end of the assistant's previous message (up to 800 characters) as context for the correction.
